§ 01

Executive Summary

Next Vision LLC is a Tulsa-based creative strategy agency, collective, and media brand built on a single conviction: Tulsa has world-class creative talent that deserves a world-class platform. We are that platform.

Funding Ask: $150,000 on a SAFE note at a $750,000 valuation cap. Deployment: full-time content coordinator, expanded production capacity, and a dedicated sales rep for Texas and Kansas. Target: 50 paying Club NVStudios clients by Month 9 and $270,000 in combined Year 1 revenue.

§ 03

Mission, Vision & Values

"We don't just do creative work — we build the infrastructure that creative economies need to sustain themselves. We exist to tell the stories that need to be told, build the brands that deserve to be seen, and create an ecosystem where creative people can earn, grow, and own something."

Value 01
Ubuntu
The community is the company. Every decision measured against its impact on people, not just profit.
Value 02
Art as Practice
Creativity is not a service delivery mechanism. It is a lived philosophy applied to every human activity.
Value 03
Cultural Roots
Tanzanian heritage, Swahili language, and East African tradition are the operating system — not the backstory.
Value 04
Earned Access
Participation is earned through demonstrated value, not financial power. In our program and in our company.
Value 05
Compounding Excellence
Every project raises the floor. We document, iterate, and build reusable systems so tomorrow benefits from today.
Vision
Million Dollar Company
Real wealth — for the founding family, for every team member who earns it, and for the communities we serve.

§ 06

Consulting Pillar

The operational gateway through which every client, partner, and collaborator engages Next Vision. Every engagement routes to the right combination of Design, Film, and Music capabilities.

Stage 01
Discovery
Deep dive into client's world, goals, audience, and creative needs. We learn before we propose.
Stage 02
Strategy
Build the creative roadmap, scope, timeline, and budget. The client knows exactly what they're getting.
Stage 03
Production
Execute with craft — drawing from Design, Film, and Music pillars as the scope requires.
Stage 04
Delivery & Retention
Present, revise, hand off. Convert to retainer — NV as an embedded creative department month over month.
NV Co-Founder
Equity Partnerships
When a concept is strong enough, NV brings creative firepower in exchange for equity stake and revenue share.

§ 09

Operations

Mwezi wa Nne — "Month of Four" in Swahili. A 28-day operating cycle within a 13-month annual calendar. Every cycle is a complete unit: scope, execute, review, close, pay out. No loose ends. No scope creep.

PhaseActivity
Week 1 (Days 1–7)Client onboarding, project scoping, planning. Contracts signed.
Week 2 (Days 8–14)Primary production — shoots, recording, design, development.
Week 3 (Days 15–21)Post-production, revision rounds, client review.
Week 4 (Days 22–28)Delivery, invoicing, retrospective, next cycle planning.
Day 28 ClosePoint payout · Pipeline review · Next cycle kickoff.

§ 11

Funding Strategy

Path A

Crowdfunding

$50K

Wefunder or Republic. Paul Said coaches two target organizations. Community already trusts the work. $10K in 72 hours is the momentum milestone.

Path B

SAFE Note · Angel Round

$150K

$750K valuation cap. After 60+ days of NVStudios MRR. 36°N Ventures, i2E OKC, Forge Tulsa. Deploys to: coordinator + production + TX/KS sales rep.

The Pitch: Most SaaS founders build for a market they researched. Next Vision built for a market it lives in. Paul Said coaches two of its target organizations. NV's CAC for its first ten clients is effectively zero. The founder is already in the room with every decision-maker in Tulsa youth sports. No capital can replicate this.

§ 12

Growth Roadmap

Phase 01 · Months 1–3

Foundation

Launch nextvisiontulsa.com. Deploy NVStudios pilot with Tulsa Diamonds. First Daraja episodes live. 2 retainer clients. Launch crowdfunding. File Tulsa Film Tribe 501(c)(3).

Phase 02 · Months 4–6

Traction

15+ NVStudios clubs. Latin soccer league outreach via Exitosa Diamonds. Hire full-time content coordinator. Begin angel conversations with live MRR. Release Genesis EP — Polito. Launch ArtistOS prototype.

Phase 03 · Months 7–12

Scale

Close $150K angel round. Open TX and KS markets with dedicated sales rep. Launch first Diamonds affiliate. Enter pre-production on NV original film. Target: 50 clubs, $270K revenue, Series A positioning.

Years 3–5

The Long Game

500+ NVStudios clubs nationally. 5+ Diamonds affiliates. NV ArtistOS national launch — zero platform cut. NV original film on festival circuit. NV studio in Tulsa. Multi-city network. Tanzania school — art as universal life practice.

A creative agency, collective, and media brand rooted in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Design. Film & Music. Consulting. Built Different.
